summary.business_type: Agency + Local Service hybrid (service-area business, Capital Region NY)
top_findings: Title tags duplicate '| MyLobstr Designs' twice on 6 pages (layout template + hardcoded page suffix)
Cloudflare robots.txt blocks GPTBot/ClaudeBot/CCBot/Google-Extended while site publishes llms.txt aimed at AI systems
www.mylobstr.com serves 200 instead of 301-redirecting to apex
Local review/citation engine not started despite existing GBP — main map-pack lever
Meta descriptions 200-250 chars on money pages; truncation risks hiding the '$300 flat' hook
quick_wins: Remove hardcoded '| MyLobstr Designs' from 6 page titles
Set up Google Search Console + Bing Webmaster Tools and submit sitemap

findings.title: www subdomain serves 200 (duplicate host)
findings.description: https://www.mylobstr.com returns 200 with full site; canonicals mitigate but 301 is correct.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare Redirect Rule www.mylobstr.com/* -> https://mylobstr.com/$1 (301).

findings.title: robots.txt missing Sitemap: directive
findings.description: Cloudflare-managed robots.txt never declares the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Append Sitemap: https://mylobstr.com/sitemap.xml.

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: All other hardening headers present.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP appropriate for the static site.

findings.title: No IndexNow
findings.description: New blog posts wait on crawl schedules for Bing/Copilot.
findings.recommendation: Enable Cloudflare Crawler Hints.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Transparent flat pricing as trust asset
City pages genuinely localized (not doorways), only 3 of them

findings.title: Cost-guide post thin vs competitors
findings.description: ~970 words targeting the most valuable informational query; competitors run 1,500-2,500.
findings.recommendation: Expand with price comparison table, FAQs, worked example.

findings.title: No visible author bylines (verify)
findings.description: Article schema present but E-E-A-T wants named authors.
findings.recommendation: Add bylines linked to /about; mirror in Article.author.

findings.title: Homepage 791 words
findings.description: Lean for head term.
findings.recommendation: Expand with process section + FAQ excerpt.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One descriptive H1 per page with local differentiation

findings.title: Brand suffix duplicated in 6 titles
findings.description: layout.tsx template %s | MyLobstr Designs + hardcoded suffix on /pricing /faq /contact /our-work and city template renders '... | MyLobstr Designs | MyLobstr Designs' (86-100 chars).
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded suffix from page titles; copy /about pattern.

findings.title: Titles exceed 60 chars after de-dup
findings.description: FAQ and city pages still 60-75 chars.
findings.recommendation: Trim middle clauses; keep city + service + brand.

findings.title: Meta descriptions 197-249 chars
findings.description: Homepage 249, city pages 209-220; target ~155.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite with $300-flat hook in first 150 chars.

findings.title: og:image missing on /about and city pages
findings.description: City pages are the most-shared in local groups.
findings.recommendation: Add openGraph.images to city template and about.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Sitewide @graph: Organization + WebSite + ProfessionalService correctly entity-linked
SAB-correct NAP: locality address, geo, phone, areaServed cities
Service + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList on city pages; Article + BreadcrumbList on posts

findings.title: contactPoint.areaServed = 'US'
findings.description: Inconsistent with Capital Region areaServed on the business entity.
findings.recommendation: Align to city list or remove.

findings.title: Verify logo.png exists at >=112px
findings.description: Organization.logo references /logo.png.
findings.recommendation: Confirm file and dimensions.

findings.title: FAQPage has no SERP feature since May 2026
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites.
findings.recommendation: Keep for AI extraction; don't add more expecting SERP benefit.

findings.title: LCP (hero H1) gated on webfonts
findings.description: Cold desktop lab LCP 4,952ms; H1 waits on ~92KB across 3 font families.
findings.recommendation: font-display swap, subset fonts, preload only above-fold faces.

findings.title: /our-work ships 1.6MB images to mobile
findings.description: 13 portfolio screenshots without responsive sizes.
findings.recommendation: Generate 2 widths with sharp; add srcset/sizes.

findings.title: No field data
findings.description: No CrUX/GSC configured; INP unmeasured.
findings.recommendation: Set up GSC; re-run /seo google when credentials exist.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Excellent llms.txt with citable pricing facts and page summaries
OAI-SearchBot + PerplexityBot + Googlebot (AI Overviews) still allowed
Clean entity data for AI parsers

findings.title: AI training crawlers blocked while llms.txt invites them
findings.description: Cloudflare-managed robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent + Content-Signal ai-train=no.
findings.recommendation: Deliberately choose: disable Cloudflare AI-bot block (recommended for a marketing site) or stop investing in llms.txt.

findings.title: llms-full.txt sync risk
findings.description: Linked from llms.txt; wrong/stale pricing there propagates into AI answers.
findings.recommendation: Add to deploy checklist.

findings.title: Money pages lack question-shaped headings
findings.description: Blog does this well; /pricing doesn't.
findings.recommendation: Add answerable H2 + one-sentence answer paragraph.

findings.title: Unresponsive portfolio images
findings.description: Same 1.6MB set served to mobile on /our-work.
findings.recommendation: srcset with pre-generated widths.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: De-duplicate title suffixes (6 pages) + trim titles/descriptions
Set up GSC + Bing WMT, submit sitemap

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Start Google review engine (target 10 text reviews)
Tier-1 citations (Bing Places, Apple, Yelp, Nextdoor, Alignable, Clutch)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Local proof on city pages; verify saratoga-springs-ny live

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monthly GBP review count + map-pack spot-check
Capture drift baseline once Phase 1 ships
Keep llms.txt in sync each deploy
